reasons.A: Short declarative sentences, clipped asides and a question followed by piled-up flat statements match the passage's dry, deadpan rhythm; the 'knew it' refrain is a little too neat, but overall closest.
reasons.B: Has the ironic mock-formal stance and some period diction, but sentences run longer and more ornate ('melancholy countenances', the cow joke) than the passage's plain, abrupt movement.
reasons.C: Long, smoothly subordinated sentences and an earnest, reflective closing moral read as a modern essayist; it lacks the passage's short bursts, exclamations and deadpan irony.
